description: Four-channel polyphonic VCA mixer for audio or CV, each channel with a level CV input and its own output, plus a chain input, clipping and DC blocking

params.text: Sets the base level of that channel's VCA, which its CV input then scales; the M button sets what the knob's range means
Sets the base level of the mix, the sum of the four channel outputs and the chain input, which the MIX CV input then scales
Cycles five level scales: unipolar dB, unipolar dB with polyphonic inputs summed to mono, and bipolar percent, x2 and x10; under a bipolar scale an unpatched input becomes a constant voltage
Cycles eight clipping settings for the mix: off, hard or soft at 10V taken before or after the mix level, oversampled soft versions of those, and a saturate at 6V
Cycles DC offset removal through off, before clipping, before and after clipping, and after clipping
Cycles six VCA responses: unipolar linear or exponential with the CV clamped, and bipolar linear or exponential, plain or band limited, where negative CV inverts and the channel ring modulates
Turned on, any channel output with a cable in it is dropped from the mix; turned off, patched channel outputs go to the mix as well

inputs.text: Scales that channel's level knob, 0V for off and 10V for unity, and it is normalled to 10V so the knob works on its own
Scales the mix level knob, 0V for off and 10V for unity, and it is normalled to 10V so the knob works on its own
One of the four channel inputs into its VCA; left unpatched under a bipolar level mode it becomes a constant voltage that the level knob sets
Polyphonic input added into the mix ahead of the mix level, for running several of these mixers in series without spending a numbered channel; normalled to 0V

outputs.text: That channel's input after its level knob and its CV, so the channel works as a VCA, a ring modulator or a constant CV source
The four channel outputs and the chain input summed, then passed through the mix level, the clipping and the DC blocking

notes: mix expanders added in an unbroken chain to the right bring mute, solo, fade, pan, offset and send controls to the four channels
menu: Oversample filter quality — 10th order by default, with 8th order and a cheaper 6th order; 10th and 8th cut at 80% of Nyquist and 6th at 50%; on the clipping and band limited VCA settings
Add Mix Offset expander (Only 1, must be 1st), Add Mix Mute expander (Only 1) and Add Mix Solo expander (Only 1) — each places that expander immediately to the right
Add Mix Fade expander (only 1, needs Mute or Solo to left), Add Mix Fade 2 expander (only 1, needs Mute or Solo to left) and Add Mix Aux Send expander — each places that expander to the right
